title: FY2024 NDAA artificial-intelligence assurance and security provisions
last_action: Enacted as part of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024.
summary: A curated group of FY2024 NDAA provisions addressing generative-AI detection and watermarking, responsible-AI processes, explainable military AI, and assessment of model and advanced-AI technologies that could pose national-security risks.
committee_dynamics: The provisions moved through the annual defense-authorization vehicle rather than as a standalone AI statute.
